{{Top|ca}}
The '''rathtar''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that could be found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Gethul}}</ref> Around [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}, the updates released in 2017 took place in [[3629 BBY]]. Since the [[Cult of Gethul uprising|mission]] where [[Gethul]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] was included in update 5.1 which was released in 2017, we can place the mission in [[3629 BBY]].</ref> rathtar [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] markers, along with those from dozens of other species, were found by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] inside [[Gethul]],<ref name="Codex" /> a creature that was hibernating under the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] and that was [[Cult of Gethul uprising|killed]] by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Uprising">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Destroyer Of Worlds}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rathtar was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Uprising" /> [[2017]]<ref name="5.1 Update">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/12317/game-update-5.1-defend-throne|text=Game Update 5.1: Defend the Throne Patch Notes}}</ref> ''Defend the Throne'' update for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="Uprising" /> The [[rathtar]] was originally introduced in the [[2015]] [[canon]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>
